name: The First War
author: Second Credit
description: Five planets, five forts to flatten: a desert, a frozen river, a jungle, a ruined port city and a volcanic works.

intro.title: The First War
intro.text:
Somewhere between two moons, two robot armies have run out of things to argue about, so they argue about planets.
The rules are simple: plant a robot on a flag and everything in that territory is yours. More ground, faster factories. Flatten their fort, keep yours.

story.title: Frost Line
story.text:
Dust Bowl is ours, and the brass is delighted, which means a colder posting. The next world is ice, cut in two by a frozen river with three bridges.
The guns on the banks belong to whoever holds the flags. Take the bridges first.

story.title: Green Hell
story.text:
Somebody thought a jungle planet would be a holiday. Two rivers, one swamp, and bridges you can count on one hand.
Pyros burn the undergrowth nicely. Try not to stand in it.

story.title: Rust Harbour
story.text:
An old port city, abandoned long before either army arrived. Straight avenues, a canal, and ruins on every corner that a tank shell will happily clear.
Snipers love a rooftop. So do lasers.

story.title: Magma Works
story.text:
Their last fort sits on a volcano, of course. Lava channels, rock walls, and factories on every ridge.
Heavy shells will crack the rock if the bridges are too crowded. End the war here.

outro.title: Ceasefire
outro.text:
The last blue fort crumbles into the lava and the radio goes quiet.
The robots stand around for a while, unsure what to do next. Then someone finds another planet on the map.
